name: CIPROFLOXACIN / DEXAMETHASONE 3.5/1 MG OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION 5 ML 1 PIECE
description: Ciprofloxacin/dexamethasone ophthalmic solution is used to treat bacterial eye infections, such as conjunctivitis or corneal ulcers, and reduce associated inflammation and redness. Ciprofloxacin is an antibiotic that fights bacteria, while dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
